whenToUse: Use for vague whole-app design system asks on an app that already ships UI, such as "our UI is a mess, fix it", "we need a design system", "we hardcode colors everywhere", "make the buttons consistent" or "check the app before I ship".
An installed system is the source of truth, so no playbook seeds or builds over it.
The state wins when it disagrees with the ask, and the report says so.
